_about: Hand-labelled failures for error analysis, grouped by run. 'label' = WHAT went wrong (symptom). 'suspected_cause' = WHY (hypothesis until verified).

_label_set.company_mismatch: Retrieved chunks are from a different company's filing
_label_set.year_mismatch: Right company, wrong fiscal year / period
_label_set.right_doc_wrong_page: Right filing retrieved, but not the gold page
_label_set.right_company_wrong_report: Right company and period, but a different report (e.g. earnings release or 8-K instead of the 10-K)

_hypotheses.H1_chunk_lacks_context: Chunks after the top of a page don't contain the company name, year or units, so the embedding can't link them to the right company. Status: SUPPORTED for company matching. With the header (retriever_4_header) there are 0 pure company mismatches among the misses (was 4). Recall@3 stayed at 60%, because new year and page failures appeared.
_hypotheses.H2_embedding_model_weak: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is small and general-purpose: it matches topic well but is weak at telling entities apart, and reads only the first 256 tokens. Status: suspected, not yet tested. Year mismatches persist even with the year in the header (e.g. 07507 gets ADOBE_2017 instead of ADOBE_2016), which fits this hypothesis.

run_H4b_filter_fix.run: retriever_8_filter_fix: extract_filters ignores case (first letter must be uppercase, so 'block' != Block), reads FY22 as 2022, knows AMEX = American Express.
run_H4b_filter_fix.dev2: New fair dev set data/dev2_20.json (make_dev2.py: 20 unused questions, 20 companies, seed 42). H4 and H4b score identically: recall 80%, MRR 81.7%, misses 3. Step 1 differs on only 1/20 case (01476 'Pepsico'), and search already found it via the H1 company header. Fix does no harm; dev2 can't show a gain.
run_H4b_filter_fix.test_CONTAMINATED: 20261122_232537_retriever_8_filter_fix_test. NOT a release score: fix was chosen after seeing these failures. Recall 73.3% -> 76.7%, MRR 76.7% -> 80.0%, misses 7 -> 6. Only 01279 fixed (year filter now removes AMD_2015). Predicted 3 fixes.
run_H4b_filter_fix.conclusion: Step 1 bugs fixed. The remaining 6 test misses are ranking problems inside the right reports: the filter now allows the right report (e.g. 00799 keeps AMCOR_2023_10K) but the embedding doesn't link 'quick ratio' / 'margin' to the balance sheet / income statement. That is H3; a filter cannot fix it.

_hypotheses_new.H3_question_vocab_gap: Judgement questions ('is X capital-intensive?', 'healthy liquidity?') use words that don't appear on the page that answers them (a balance sheet never says 'quick ratio'). Status: STRONGLY SUPPORTED. 3/3 H2 dev misses and 5/6 H4b test misses fit it. Not yet tested with a fix.
